skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and manage the structure and operation of Unix/Linux systems, including file systems, shell scripting, and network services.
Develop and execute shell scripts for automation and system management tasks.
Configure and manage network services such as FTP, DNS, DHCP, Web, and Mail servers.
Manage file systems, including permissions, redirection, and security mechanisms.
Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues related to system operations.
Work effectively in teams, present findings, and communicate technical information in English.
Demonstrate self-reliance and responsibility in independent work and group projects.
